description: This file defines a React functional component named 'Screen' which manages layout and navigation logic for a web application. It handles authentication-based rendering, responsive layout adjustments based on device type (mobile, iOS), and supports dynamic styling with inline styles and CSS classes. The component utilizes hooks to detect screen size and window resize events, and conditionally renders sidebar and main content areas.

methods.name: Screen
methods.description: React functional component that renders a responsive layout with conditional sidebar and content areas based on authentication status and device type.
